subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for your upcoming trip to New York City has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XYZ123 Departure: Date, Time Arrival: Date, Time Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure.
